WITH plan_data AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code) AS account_code, SUM(p.amount) AS plan_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN m ON p.account_code = m.gl_account_code
        WHERE p.version_id = 2
          AND p.period = '2026-09'
          
          
          
          
        GROUP BY 1
      ),
      actual_data AS (
        SELECT a.plan_account_code AS account_code, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS actual_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.period = '2026-09'
          
          
          
          
        GROUP BY a.plan_account_code
      ),
      ytd_plan AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(m.plan_account_code, p.account_code) AS account_code, SUM(p.amount) AS ytd_plan_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
        LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN m ON p.account_code = m.gl_account_code
        WHERE p.version_id = 2
          AND p.period <= '2026-09' AND period >= '2026-01'
          
          
          
          
        GROUP BY 1
      ),
      ytd_actual AS (
        SELECT a.plan_account_code AS account_code, SUM(a.mapped_amount) AS ytd_actual_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS a
        WHERE a.period <= '2026-09' AND period >= '2026-01'
          
          
          
          
        GROUP BY a.plan_account_code
      )
      SELECT
        d.account_code,
        d.account_name,
        d.statement_section,
        d.parent_account_code,
        d.is_leaf,
        d.sign_convention,
        d.sort_order,
        COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) AS actual,
        COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) AS plan,
        COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) AS delta,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) != 0
          THEN ((COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0)) / ABS(p.plan_amount)) * 100
          ELSE 0
        END AS delta_pct,
        COALESCE(ya.ytd_actual_amount, 0) AS ytd_actual,
        COALESCE(yp.ytd_plan_amount, 0) AS ytd_plan,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(yp.ytd_plan_amount, 0) != 0
          THEN ((COALESCE(ya.ytd_actual_amount, 0) - COALESCE(yp.ytd_plan_amount, 0)) / ABS(yp.ytd_plan_amount)) * 100
          ELSE 0
        END AS ytd_delta_pct
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT d
      LEFT JOIN plan_data p ON p.account_code = d.account_code
      LEFT JOIN actual_data a ON a.account_code = d.account_code
      LEFT JOIN ytd_plan yp ON yp.account_code = d.account_code
      LEFT JOIN ytd_actual ya ON ya.account_code = d.account_code
      WHERE d.account_type = 'IS'
      ORDER BY d.sort_order
